spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (पनायति)
To praise: this root and पण in the same sense, take आय before the Sārvadhātuka, and some of the Ārddhadhātuka, affixes.
(पनते)
To traffic, to buy and sell: see पण.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Fallen, gone down or downwards.
2 Gone.
m. (-न्नः)
Downward motion, falling, descending.
E.
पद to go, aff. क्त, deriv. irr., otherwise पद to go, Uṇādi aff. नन्.

Drinking.
2

A drinking cup or vessel.
3 Preserving, protecting.
m. (-नः)
1 Breath, breathing out, expiration.
2 A distiller.
E.
पा to drink, &c. aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-सः)
1 The bread fruit or Jaka tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.)
2 A thorn.
3 The name of a monkey.
f. (-सा)
A malady, pustular and phlegmonoid inflammation of the skin or external organs.
2 A she monkey.
3 A female demon.
E.
पन to praise or be praised, Uṇādi aff. असच्.

n. (-सं)
A spirituous liquor prepared from the fruit of the Jack tree.
E.
पनस the Jack, and अण् aff.

f. (-का)
The bread-fruit or Jack.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Produced in or on the road.
E.
पथिन्, and वुन् aff.

m. (-गः)
1 A snake.
2 A drug: see पद्मकाष्ठ.
f. (-गी)
The snake goddess MANASĀ.
E.
पन्न fallen, ग who goes, or पद् a foot, न not, ग who goes; moving without feet.

m. (-नः)
A name of GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU.
E.
पन्नग a snake, and अशन food; the snake-eater.

f. (-द्धा)
A leather shoe or boot.
E.
पद् a foot, नह to bind, aff. क्त, deriv. irr.

f. (-द्धी)
A shoe, a boot.
E.
पद् a foot, नह to bind, aff. ष्ट्रन्, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Linear, in or by line, or row.
E.
पंक्ति a line, aff. अण्.

m. (-वः)
Rock or fossile salt.
E.
पांशु dust, and अण् aff.

Dust.
2

Manure.
3

Landed property.
E.
पशि to bind, Uṇādi aff. कु; also पांसु.

Dust.
2

Manure.
E.
पसि to bind, &c., aff. कु, also पांशु.

f. (-का)
1 A menstruous woman.
2 A fragrant plant, (Pandanus odoratissimus.)

n. (-सं)
Sulphuret of iron.
E.
पांशु dust, and कासीस the same.

f. (-ली)
A principal road.
E.
पांशु dust, कुल a heap.

n. (-लं)
A blank lease, a title deed, one not made out in any person's name.
E.
पांशु landed property, कूल a mound, (as it were.)

m. (-रः)
Hail.
E.
पांशु dust, चत्वर a level space.

m. (-नः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
पांशु dust, चन्दन Sandal.

m. (-रः)
1 A tent.
2 A bank overgrown with Dūrbbā grass.
3

Praise.
4

A heap of dust.
5 A small cucumber.
E.
पांशु dust, चामर a chowri.

n. (-जं)
Salt extracted from soil, rock or fossile salt.
E.
पांशु dust, ज born.

n. (-त्रं)
A potherb, (Chenopodium album.)
E.
पांशु dust, and पत्र leaf.

m. (-नः)
A channel or basin for water, near or about the root of a tree.
E.
पांशु dust, and मर्द्दन destroying.

m. (-वः)
A cripple: see पीठसर्पिन्.

m. (-रः)
1 A gadfly.
2 A cripple carried or moving about in a chair.
E.
पांशु dust, and रा to get, क or ड aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Dusty, covered or spotted with dust.
m. (-लः)
1 A name of Ś

IVA.
2

One of ŚIVA'S weapons; a sort of pole armed at the upper end with transverse pieces, representing the breastbone and ribs adjoining, and surmounted by a skull; also खद्वाङ्ग.
3 A paramour, a gallant.
4 A kind of tree, (Cæsalpinia bonducella.)
f. (-ला)
1 An unchaste woman.
2 A woman during menstruation.
3 The earth.
E.
पांशु dust, लच् aff.

m. (-र्षः)
A shower or fall of dust.
E.
पांशु, and वर्ष rain.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Contemptible, vile.
2 Vitiating, spoiling.
E.
पसि to destroy, ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Contemptible, wicked, bad, infamous.
2 Vitiating, spoiling, destructive.
E.
पसि to destroy, aff. ल्युट्

f. (-का)
A dram shop, a place where people drink together.
E.
पान drinking, गोष्ठी a station, aff. कन्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Drinking, quaffing, who or what drinks assiduously.
2 Looking at amorously.
E.
पान, and पर intent.

n. (-त्रं)
A glass, a drinking vessel.
E.
पान drinking, पात्र a vessel.

m. (-णिक्)
A distiller, a vender of spirits.
E.
पान drinking, बणिज् a dealer.

n. (-नं)
A drinking vessel, a glass, a goblet.
E.
पान, and भाजन a vessel.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Drinking, drunken.
E.
पान, and रत engaged in.

m. (-ण्डः)
A hard drinker.
E.
पान, and शौण्ड intoxicated.

m. (-यः)
Morbid state after intoxication.
E.
पान, and अत्यय end.

n. (-लं)
A drinking vessel.
E.
पान drinking, and इलच् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Drinkable, to be drunk.
2 To be cherished, protected or preserved.
n. (-यं)
Water.
E.
पा to drink, अनीयर participial aff.

m. (-लः)
An otter.
E.
पानीय water, नकुल an ichneumon.

m. (-जः)
An aquatick plant, (Pistia stratiotes.)
E.
पानीय water, पृष्ठ surface, ज born.

m. (-कः)
A plant, (Serratula anthelmintica): see सोमराजी.
E.
पानीय water, मूल root, कन् aff.

f. (-का)
A place where water, &c. is distributed.
E.
पानीय water, शाला a place, aff. कन्.

n. (-कं)
A fruit, (Flacourtia cataphracta.)
E.
पानीय water, and आमलक myrobalan.

mf. (-न्यः-न्या)
A traveller.
E.
पथिन् a road, and अण् aff.
